targetCompanyImage.name: Skyservice US
targetCompanyImage.subsector: U.S. fixed-base operations and aircraft services
targetCompanyImage.description: Skyservice US represents the U.S. fixed-base operation and aircraft services footprint that originated in Leading Edge Jet Center and now operates under the Skyservice brand. The business serves business aviation customers with fueling, hangar, maintenance, aircraft-on-ground support, and related airport services in the Pacific Northwest and Montana. Its operating model is asset-heavy because it relies on leased or controlled airport facilities, hangars, line-service operations, and maintenance capabilities at each location. Public disclosures state that Leading Edge Jet Center was founded in 2005 and that four U.S. locations were rebranded under the Skyservice banner in 2021. Instar's broader Canadian Skyservice investment dates to 2017, while Instar's fact sheet identifies Skyservice US, formerly Leading Edge Jet Center, as a 2019 portfolio company.

seedEntry.name: Skyservice US
seedEntry.subsector: Fixed-base operations and business aviation services
seedEntry.description: Skyservice US provides fixed-base operations, aircraft fueling, maintenance, hangar, and related business aviation services in the Pacific Northwest. Its customers are business aviation operators, aircraft owners, charter users, and other aviation clients requiring ground services and support infrastructure. The operating model is asset-heavy because the business relies on airport leases, hangars, fueling systems, maintenance capabilities, and service facilities across its network. Instar portfolio materials identify Skyservice and Skyservice US as a North American business aviation services platform, while other public materials note that the U.S. operations originated in Leading Edge Jet Center. Leading Edge Jet Center was founded in 2005, Instar added the U.S. platform to its portfolio before integration with Skyservice in 2019, and the detailed current ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
